title: Democrats Flip North Carolina Senate Seat
summary: The Democrats flipped their first Senate seat of the night. Our national political correspondent Shane Goldmacher explains why this wasn’t a surprise, and why it’s one of at least four seats the party needs to win to secure a majority in the Senate.

title: More Iranians Call for Nuclear Weapons After War With U.S.
summary: Some Iranian clerics and officials argue the country must rebuild deterrence by dropping its longstanding pledge not to build a nuclear bomb.

title: Trump Says U.S. to End $4 Billion in Aid to Israel at End of Year
summary: The president’s announcement on Election Day, which he said was part of an agreement reached months ago, was a sign of how quickly the politics surrounding Israel have shifted.

title: Israeli Claims of Iranian Chemical Weapons Divide U.S. Officials
summary: Some administration officials suggested Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is trying to draw President Trump back into military action.

title: A Test for Israeli Democracy: Should Jews Ask Arabs to Join the Government?
summary: Arab lawmakers give opponents of Benjamin Netanyahu a clear majority in the Parliament. But many Jewish lawmakers are trying to avoid relying on them.

title: America Votes
summary: Your guide to election night, and more big stories at the end of Tuesday.

title: Key Part of Jet in Deadly Florida Crash Found Far From Impact Site
summary: The mechanism that controls the vertical angle of the plane was found in three pieces, including one nearly four miles away. All nine people aboard were killed.

title: Investigators Looking for Cause of Learjet Crash Say Ice Was ‘Certainly a Factor’
summary: Ice, experts said, can change the shape of a plane’s wing, disrupting its aerodynamics.

title: U.S. Assisted Venezuela in Deadly Drone Strike, Officials Say
summary: The attack on a drug-trafficking group killed about two dozen people, a rights group said. It comes as the United States is militarizing the fight against “narcoterrorism” in Latin America.

title: Trump Pushes Venezuela for Agreement Allowing U.S. Troops to Stay
summary: The two countries have long been adversaries, and the United States attacked Venezuela this year, but Secretary of State Marco Rubio is starting talks on a legal agreement.

title: An 80-Cent Plastic Pouch Is Saving Thousands of Women From Dying in Childbirth
summary: The maternal drape, as it is called, is helping to solve one of the world’s most intractable health problems.

title: Is Sysco Making Every Restaurant the Same, or Saving Small Business Owners?
summary: Depending on whom you ask, the giant food distributor is flattening the way we eat, or helping small business owners survive. Maybe both are true?

title: ‘Trump Has Left Republicans in a Highly Perilous Position’: Opinion Writers Assess the Midterms
summary: Kristen Soltis Anderson and Jamelle Bouie talk about the ethical dimension of some of the races this year. They are joined by Matthew Yglesias.

title: Jon Ossoff Suddenly Looks Even More Presidential
summary: Fighting corruption, the theme in his race, could work for Democrats in 2028.

title: Chris Murphy, Recovering From a Stroke, Remains Hospitalized on Election Day
summary: The Democratic senator from Connecticut, who is 53, began experiencing symptoms while attending his son’s hockey game on Saturday, his office said.
